[strike](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/3/3/israel-strikes-lebanons-

[advanced](https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/lebanon-sucked-deeper-

- marking a major escalation in the war with Iran and raising fears Israel may
be considering a broad, full-scale invasion of Lebanon. Hezbollah, which
launched missiles toward Israel for a second day,
[said](https://apnews.com/live/iran-war-israel-
trump-03-03-2026#0000019c-b341-d180-abfe-bbc3cb950000) Israel wanted an "open
war, which it has not stopped since the ceasefire agreement…So let it be an
open war."_

around Capitol Hill. And boy oh boy, do we have a lot to talk about…

In today's '**First Draft** :' **Donald Trump 's** administration says the
quiet part loud on **Iran** and**Israel** - causing **Democrats** across
previous ideological spectrums to coalesce around a new anti-war stance and
Republicans to flounder; local officials are investigating Border Patrol
leader **Greg Bovino** , the disgraced face of Trump's occupation of
**Minneapolis** ; more from the **Epstein files** ; and we have the latest
from the US and Israel's illegal **war with Iran**.

# 'So Much For America First'

[![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!n89K!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-
post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F6111f36f-cf22-42cc-
ba56-3304a7ac5a0f_2000x1333.jpeg)](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!n89K!,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-

ba56-3304a7ac5a0f_2000x1333.jpeg)_Marco Rubio at the US Capitol on March 2,
2026. Photo by Nathan Posner/Anadolu via Getty Images._

On Monday, Secretary of State Marco Rubio made the subtext the text: The US
launched its already devastating war on Iran for… the sake of Israel.

After meeting with lawmakers on Capitol Hill, Rubio [told
reporters](https://x.com/acyn/status/2028573242173366282?s=12) that **" it was
abundantly clear that if Iran came under attack by anyone, the United States
or Israel or anyone, they were going to respond and respond against the United
States."**

He added: **" We knew that there was going to be an Israeli action, we knew
that that would precipitate an attack against American forces, and we knew
that if we didn't preemptively go after them before they launched those
attacks, we would suffer higher casualties and perhaps even higher those
killed, and then we would all be here answering questions about why we knew
that and didn't act."**

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

The Trump administration has maintained that it launched its war on Iran
because of some **["imminent threat"](https://zeteo.com/p/international-law-
trump-israel-war-iran-illegal)** Iran was posing. An argument already tenuous,
given that months ago, the administration claimed to have **" obliterated"**
Iran's looming nuclear facilities (which was since proven wrong); and given
there was actually [more proof](https://www.commondreams.org/news/oman-
foreign-minister-iran-deal) that, instead of posing a threat, Iran had been
approaching a possible deal with the US.

But now, Rubio has said the truth, clearly. The **" imminent threat"** was
that they knew Israel was about to attack Iran. And thus, Iran would surely
retaliate by attacking US bases. And so, the logic goes, the US _had to_
attack Iran first - completely abandoning ongoing negotiations. Notably, the
US _stopping_ Israel __ from attacking Iran wasn't apparently on the menu.

Republicans on Capitol Hill were hesitant to respond, sometimes giving
puzzling answers. Senator Lisa Murkowski, for example, when asked about the
secretary of state's comments, said she wasn't going to speak on **" any of
these comments."** Instead, she said, she was going to have a "unique
opportunity" alongside her Senate colleagues **" to hear from the secretary of
state, the secretary of defense, and others"** and listen to what's presented
to them.

The perennially evolving statements from the administration are tying
Republicans in knots. **" This is not a so-called regime change war, but the
regime sure did change,"** Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said Sunday.

On Monday, Senator Tim Sheehy was asked about his _own_ description of the war
as **" regime change,"** versus Hegseth's comments. The Montana Republican
[settled on](https://x.com/atrupar/status/2028660634032779444?s=20): **" I
think the reason you're hearing so many varied reasons is the varied threats
this regime presents."**

As Republicans stumble, rank-and-file Democrats seem to be finding meaningful
consensus.

Virginia Senator Tim Kaine slammed Rubio's twisted logic on the **" imminent
threat"** presented by Israel's own desire to attack Iran. **" That is what's
called a pretext, not an imminent threat."**

**" Our foreign policy is not determined by what some other nation does. It
should be determined by our own national interest,"** Kaine added.

Senator Richard Blumenthal of Connecticut, a member of the armed services and
homeland security committees, said he and his colleagues on the intelligence
committee have seen no intel to suggest there was an **" imminent threat"**
posed by Iran, and said Rubio's comments **" undercut"** his administration's
own argument for war.

Some members were bemused in their assessments. Oregon Senator Jeff Merkley
kept his criticism of Rubio's logic succinct:** "sounds like bullshit to me."
**

[Share](https://zeteo.com/p/first-draft-trump-iran-marco-rubio-

JNtkLI8wpsfw)

**" So, Netanyahu now decides when we go to war? So much for America First,"**
Senator Ruben Gallego
[tweeted](https://x.com/RubenGallego/status/2028596637019324574?s=20) Monday.

I asked Hawaii Senator Brian Schatz about Rubio's logic. He mocked it. **" I
mean, an imminent threat is that one country might attack another country, and
neither of those [is] our country? He's a smooth talker, but that makes no
damn sense. And everybody knows it,"** he told me.

**" Part of what they're trying to get away with is they think we're in an
information environment, in which case you can say whatever you feel like
saying. But this is different,"** Schatz continued. **" This is war, this is a
regime change in the Middle East. Everybody is very dialed into the details.
And that kind of bullshittery is not going to work with the American public.
There was not an imminent threat. Israel attacking Iran does not constitute an
imminent threat to the United States of America."**

Just as Rubio delivered his shocking comments on the Hill, Trump took to Truth
Social to tell people to watch Benjamin Netanyahu on Sean Hannity's show. Why
the US president was serving as the Israeli prime minister's press secretary
was unclear. What transpired was just as befuddling. Asked by Hannity about
**" people that say"** he dragged Trump into the war, Netanyahu
[responded](https://x.com/atrupar/status/2028657491362423115?s=20) with a low,
four-second laugh.

He went on to say he's tried to persuade repeated US administrations to **"
take action"** on Iran. And, to his joy, Trump (and _only Trump!_) finally
agreed.

**" There's never been a president like Donald J. Trump,"** Netanyahu
concluded.

That's for sure.

## 🇮🇷 Iran War Updates

  * **Death tolls:** The death toll in Iran from US-Israeli strikes climbed to more than 785, the country's Red Crescent Society [said](https://x.com/Iranian_RCS/status/2028759981781057681) today. Six US troops have been killed as of yesterday afternoon, per [US Central Command](https://x.com/CENTCOM/status/2028576582445437039). Dozens of others have been killed across the region.

  * **US embassies hit:** Trump [warned](https://www.newsnationnow.com/politics/trump-us-retaliate-deaths-drone-attack/) late Monday that "you'll find out soon" what the US retaliation would be after the US embassy in Riyadh was struck by Iranian drones. Iran also [reportedly](https://www.nbcnews.com/world/iran/live-blog/iran-israel-us-attack-trump-live-updates-rcna261438) hit the US embassy compound in Kuwait. No injuries have been reported. 

  * **Americans stranded:** The US Embassy in Jerusalem [said](https://x.com/usembassyjlm/status/2028721343881994304) today that it could not help "evacuate or directly assist Americans in departing Israel," despite the State Department telling US citizens across the region to leave immediately. Meanwhile, the State Department said it was evacuating non-emergency personnel from the UAE, Bahrain, Iraq, Jordan, Kuwait, and Qatar. 

  * **Iranian school girls remembered:** Thousands [attended](https://www.nytimes.com/live/2026/03/03/world/iran-war-israel-lebanon-trump/22c6e5d0-df61-5cb1-a0d8-7109680e8a2c?smid=url-share) a mass funeral in the Iranian town of Minab today, after a strike hit an elementary school, reportedly killing 175 people, including many school girls. 

  * **Ground troops?:** Trump told the _[New York Post](https://nypost.com/2026/03/02/us-news/trump-wont-rule-out-sending-us-troops-into-iran-if-necessary-tells-the-post-i-dont-care-about-polling/)_ that while he doesn't believe US ground troops in Iran are necessary at the moment, he wouldn't rule out putting troops on the ground. Separately, in his first live remarks about the war, Trump said his administration had projected the war to last "four to five weeks" but [signaled](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/03/02/world/middleeast/iran-war-us-israel-trump.html) it could be longer: "Whatever the time is, it's OK, whatever it takes," he said before quickly transitioning to talking about his ballroom project. 

  * **Hegseth 's admission: **In unhinged remarks about the war with Iran yesterday, US Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth [said](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/mar/02/hegseth-iran-war-first-remarks), "No stupid rules of engagement, no nation-building quagmire, no democracy-building exercise, no politically correct wars. We fight to win and we don't waste time, or lives."

  * **Tucker 's Mossad claim: **Tucker Carlson yesterday [claimed](https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/tucker-carlson-says-saudi-qatar-arrested-mossad-agents-planning-bombings), without providing evidence, that Saudi Arabia and Qatar "arrested Israeli Mossad agents planning bombings" in their countries. Qatar's foreign minister later [said](https://aje.news/xgc2gx?update=4358871) there was no information on Mossad agents operating in the country.

## **🗞 ️ **What You Need to Know

  * **Third time 's a charm:** A federal judge [halted](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/03/02/lawmaker-access-ice-detention-ruling-00807198) Homeland Security Kristi Noem's illegal policy restricting members of Congress from making unannounced visits to ICE detention centers. This is now the _third_ time that this judge had to push back against Noem's outrageous attempts to hide the inhumane conditions inside of ICE facilities from lawmakers.

  * **Refund NOW:** Trump's administration attempted to delay the Supreme Court's ruling ordering it to issue refunds for his illegal tariffs, but an appeals court swiftly [rejected](https://www.kpvi.com/news/national_news/us-appeals-court-denies-trump-bid-to-delay-tariff-refund-lawsuits/article_3da6f285-1753-5dab-ae11-3f79f13fb4e0.html) it. The White House will now have to go before a lower court to begin legal proceedings in carrying out the Supreme Court's orders.

  * **Epstein latest:** The DOJ failed to [pursue](https://www.wsj.com/us-news/law/doj-examined-men-in-epsteins-orbit-accused-of-sex-crimes-none-was-charged-bcc98830) charges against men in Epstein's circle who were accused of sexual assault - even when several victims were willing to help officials with investigations into these men. Records in the recent batch of Epstein files reveal that federal prosecutors interviewed at least seven victims of Epstein and his co-conspirators, but claim that they did not have enough evidence to charge the men named in these interviews.

  * **Investigating the feds:** A Minnesota county attorney's office is [collecting](https://www.startribune.com/greg-bovino-other-federal-agents-investigated-for-actions-during-operation-metro-surge/601591378) evidence from citizens of ICE's unlawful behavior. The new initiative, called the Transparency and Accountability Project, is already investigating a number of incidents, including one in which since-demoted Border Patrol commander Greg Bovino was filmed tossing chemicals toward protesters.

## 🌏 Anywhere But America

  * **🇵 🇸 Don't forget Gaza: **Gaza is running out of food and fuel, [officials told Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/gaza-fuel-running-short-after-israel-closes-borders-amid-iran-war-2026-03-02/), after Israel closed all border crossings. The UN said Israel [agreed](https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/key-gaza-crossing-will-be-reopened-says-world-food-programme-2026-03-03/) to temporarily reopen the Karem Shalom crossing today to gradually allow aid into the Strip, but the Rafah crossing will remain closed - blocking the only way for Palestinians in desperate need of medical treatment to leave the Strip. 

  * **🇸 🇸 Mass atrocities in South Sudan: **At least 169 people were [killed](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/3/2/nearly-170-people-killed-in-attack-in-south-sudans-ruweng-officials-says) after dozens of armed men attacked a town in South Sudan's Ruweng Administrative Area, according to local officials. At least 90 people killed were civilians, while the remaining 79 were government soldiers.

  * 🇭🇹 **Election rumblings:** Haiti officially opened a 10-day [registration window](https://apnews.com/article/haiti-elections-party-registration-council-gangs-86a6f681d62827d496e2d358940bd12f) for political parties to run in an upcoming general election - the first in more than a decade as the island nation continues to grapple with deadly gang violence.

  * 🇦🇷 **Milei 's labor reform under fire**: Argentina's largest trade union [filed a lawsuit](https://apnews.com/article/argentina-labor-reform-milei-workers-lawsuit-5a0a6e83a0c1809f626c29e92789498d) to block President Javier Milei's sweeping labor reform, which would limit unions' bargaining power across the country. The General Confederation of Labor (CGT) claimed that Milei's reform is unconstitutional and will roll back key worker protections.

  * 🇬🇧 **Stunning poll** : A [YouGov poll for Sky News](http://news.sky.com/story/greens-overtake-labour-in-sensational-poll-13514420) shows the Green Party, which just pulled off a historic victory in Gorton and Denton by-election, "leapfrogged" Labour and is now the most popular party across all age groups for people under 50. The hard-right Reform UK still leads the weekly voter intention poll at 23%, down one point, while the Greens jumped four points to 21%, and Labour and the Tories are both down two points at 16%.
